scenes.title: Cut the Green and Yellow Wire
scenes.summary: Over the radio, a colleague and an organizer tell a bomb-squad employee to cut the green and yellow wire, but he hesitates out of patriotic attachment.
scenes.location: bomb disposal site and radio command center

scenes.title: The Inactive Red Wire
scenes.summary: The colleague explains that the red wire has zero signal, which only convinces the employee that the red wire is slacking off while the green and yellow one does all the work.
scenes.location: bomb disposal site and radio command center

scenes.title: Printed Mapping Only
scenes.summary: The employee demands printed schematics, dismisses his colleague's electrical engineering doctorate, and cuts the red wire.
scenes.location: bomb disposal site and radio command center

scenes.title: Blame It on the Red Wire
scenes.summary: Heavily injured after the explosion, the presenter records a video blaming the red wire and calling followers to a Sunday protest.
